top_choice_rationale: The GLP-1 physiology proposal combines a mature, clearly defined physiological achievement with exceptionally broad and durable demonstrated benefit in diabetes and obesity. The narrowly framed citation supports a coherent Holst-Mojsov-Drucker allocation while avoiding crediting the full subsequent therapeutic-development enterprise.
recusal_note: No candidate-specific connection requiring recusal is apparent from the supplied profile. It records prior work with Paul Greengard and approximately twenty coauthored works with committee member Thomas Perlmann; neither is a documented connection to a shortlisted candidate.
